requirements.verifier_assertion: from streamlit.testing import AppTest must be the same class as from streamlit.testing.v1 import AppTest (test_top_level_apptest_alias_is_the_v1_class: TopLevelAppTest is V1AppTest)
AppTest.from_string(script).run() executes script headlessly; run() returns self; at.markdown[0].value matches expected output (test_run_simple_script_from_string)
from_string handles indented source by auto-dedenting common leading whitespace (test_from_string_dedents_indented_source)
AppTest.from_function(fn).run() treats function body as script (test_construction_from_function)
from_function must not include the def line in the executed script — it would cause SyntaxError (test_construction_from_function_body_ignores_signature)
AppTest.from_file(path).run() loads and executes a script file (test_construction_from_file)
st.title/header/subheader/text/caption/code/divider/latex produce queryable elements with correct .value (test_static_text_elements)
Element .type matches the accessor name (at.title[0].type == 'title', etc.) enabling at.get() equivalence (test_static_element_type_labels)

st.info/warning/error/success produce separate typed lists; at.info, at.warning, at.error, at.success each isolated; .type matches kind; at.get('warning') works (test_alert_elements_are_categorised_by_kind)
Alert elements do not appear in at.markdown or at.text lists (test_alerts_do_not_appear_in_markdown_or_text_lists)
Widget elements expose .label, .key, .help, .disabled properties (test_widget_properties_exposed)
button.click().run() makes st.button() return True; subsequent run() without click reverts to False (test_button_click_observed_by_script_once)
button.click() returns self (same object) for chaining (test_button_click_returns_self_for_chaining)
checkbox.check()/uncheck() roundtrips with session_state[key] (test_checkbox_roundtrip_with_session_state)
text_input.input(str) and text_area.input(str) update .value and affect script output (test_text_widgets)
number_input.increment()/decrement()/set_value() with min/max/step (test_number_input_controls)
radio.set_value(), radio.options, selectbox.select()/select_index()/index, multiselect.select()/unselect() (test_option_widgets)
slider.set_value(), slider.set_range() for range sliders, select_slider.set_value() (test_sliders)
date_input/time_input/color_picker .set_value() with datetime.date, datetime.time, hex color string (test_date_time_color_widgets)
at.main and at.sidebar return independent element scopes; sidebar button not in main, main markdown not in sidebar (test_sidebar_is_separate_from_main)
Alert elements in sidebar stay in at.sidebar, not in at.main (test_sidebar_alerts_stay_in_sidebar)
Root at has len()==2, at[0].type=='main', at[1].type=='sidebar'; at.main supports len and indexing; at.get() works (test_tree_navigation)
at.get('nonexistent') returns empty iterable/indexable without crashing (test_get_unknown_element_type_is_empty)
session_state persists across reruns, preset values visible to script, counter increments across runs (test_session_state_lifecycle)
Widget with key= binds to session_state[key] — input changes reflected in both (test_widget_key_binds_to_session_state)
at.query_params['q'] = 'answer' before run; script reads via st.experimental_get_query_params() (test_query_params_passed_to_script)
Script exception captured: at.exception[0].value contains 'kaboom-42', stack_trace contains 'ValueError' (test_script_exception_is_captured)
NameError captured: at.exception[0].message contains the undefined name (test_undefined_name_surfaces_as_exception)
at.run(timeout=1) on a sleeping script raises RuntimeError (test_run_timeout_raises)
@st.cache_data function returns same value across multiple run() calls (test_cache_results_stable_across_reruns)
Multiple widget modifications before one run() all apply together (test_batched_interactions_apply_on_next_run)
Accessors for absent widget/element types return empty lists, including new alert accessors (test_missing_widget_types_yield_empty_lists)
InteractiveScriptTests emits DeprecationWarning on instantiation; message contains both 'InteractiveScriptTests' and 'AppTest' (test_old_interactive_script_tests_still_works_but_warns)
DeprecationWarning is matchable via pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning, match=r'AppTest') (test_deprecation_warning_is_matchable_by_pytest_warns)
Widget .id property is stable across reruns — same widget keeps same id after value change (test_widget_id_stable_across_reruns)
